description: Department of Forest Conservation - State Lands Elamaradankulam and Niliyamote 01 as Reserved Forests - Elamaradankulam reserved Forest and Niliyamote 01 reserved Forest are subjected to the single control of the Conservator General of Forests
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land matters, specifically the declaration of state land as a Reserved Forest under the Forest Conservation Ordinance. The core content focuses on land boundaries, coordinates, and land use classification (forest conservation), which falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4). While a government official (State Minister) is named, this is incidental to the land declaration process and does not involve government structural changes, personnel appointments, or detailed portfolio responsibilities that would trigger a government-related classification (Types 1-3).
